```python
def get_homogeneous_numpy_compatible_type_of_seq(seq):
    if not seq:
        return None
    type_of_first = type(seq[0])
    numpy_type = PYTHON_TYPE_TO_NUMPY_TYPE.get(type_of_first)
    if numpy_type is None:
        return None
    for item in seq[1:]:
        if type(item) is not type_of_first:
            return None
    return numpy_type
```
